observation.command:
cd /tmp/nebu-validate 2>/dev/null || { mkdir -p /tmp/nebu-validate; cd /tmp/nebu-validate; }
DEXAUTH=$(grep -i '^location:' sso_h.txt | awk '{print $2}' | tr -d '\r')
echo "=== follow dex auth redirects ==="
curl -sSL -m 15 -c dex_cookies.txt -o dex_auth_full.html -w 'final_url:%{url_effective}\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n' "$DEXAUTH"
echo "=== login form fields ==="
grep -o '<form[^>]*>' dex_auth_full.html
grep -o 'name="[a-z_]*"' dex_auth_full.html | sort -u
